propositions: Reconcile passes must validate every mapped project and legacy_default is visible to the bridge bot BEFORE any mutation, preventing incident class where decommissioned/permission-lost projects surface only deep in fan-out as ACLI errors.
A nonexistent or invisible legacy_default causes unguarded CREATE storm into wrong project because resolve_project returns it verbatim and cross-project write guard excludes creates.

Preflight probe enumerates bot-visible keys via AcliClient._direct_rest_get against Jira Cloud GET /rest/api/3/project/search with pagination, failing closed on page-cap exhaustion without clean termination.

Preflight helper catches transport faults (HTTPError, URLError, TimeoutError, ConnectionError, JSON errors) and maps them to TransportUnavailableError separate from ProjectVisibilityError, preserving fail-closed semantics.

Wiring gates on Cloud backend (reconciler.backend == 'jira') and skips non-Cloud backends and clients lacking _direct_rest_get; preflight aborts mutating passes before reconcile_once, converting to OPERATIONAL_FAILURE PassResult with observable error message naming missing keys.
Preflight is skipped for read-only passes (route == 'preview', target_mode in dry-run/reconcile-check) and when projects mapping is empty with no query_project fallback.
